items.statement: Increasing H* coverage from 0 to 7/9 ML raises Volmer barriers but lowers Heyrovsky barriers at the stated Fig. 2 potentials, while a consistently referenced overall Volmer-Tafel reaction energy is coverage invariant.
items.expected_result: Coverage analysis distinguishes the opposite Volmer and Heyrovsky barrier changes shown in Fig. 2a and SI Tables 6/7 from overall thermodynamic reference consistency; unresolved deviations require computed evidence and an uncertainty account.
